_readme: DUET's skills: a new phone capability is one entry here, with no code. The agent turns each entry into a tool (duet_voice/galaxy/skills.py) that inherits the coordinator's guarantees: the commit gate's hold, the ledger (never twice), the guards (cut off, undecided, dropped), consent when marked, and a confirmation said only after the phone reports it done. The phone app runs it with one generic executor (app/www/phone.js). The laptop's copy of this file is read by the app at each conversation start, so a new skill needs no new APK. Settings are system settings only (what Android lets an app with 'Modify system settings' change). Fields: name, modes, kind (read | write | ui), consent, named (a regular expression for the words that name it: the fast mind may then act on it), description, parameters (JSON schema properties), required, group (the ledger: a later change of the same group replaces an earlier one), label (the timeline), confirm (what DUET says when it is done), run (the executor: setting | intent | dnd), verify (read the setting back: done only if it holds). Templates: {arg} is the value, {arg?A:B} is A when the argument is true, else B.

skills.name: set_auto_rotate
skills.description: Turn the screen's auto-rotate on or off.

on.description: true to turn auto-rotate on, false to lock the screen's orientation.

skills.label: Auto-rotate {on?on:off}

skills.name: set_text_size
skills.description: Make the text on the phone's screen bigger or smaller, for every app.
skills.label: Text size: {size}

skills.name: set_do_not_disturb
skills.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on (calls and notifications stay quiet, alarms still ring) or off.

on.description: true to turn Do Not Disturb on, false to turn it off.

skills.label: Do Not Disturb {on?on:off}

skills.name: open_camera
skills.description: Open the camera, ready to take a photo.
skills.label: Open the camera

skills.name: open_wifi_panel
skills.description: Show the Wi-Fi panel so the user can pick or switch a network (Android lets apps show it, not switch Wi-Fi by themselves).
skills.label: Show the Wi-Fi panel
